If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) over last 5 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.

If sentiment is mixed (0.33–0.67) and price is trending upward, add 0.5–1.0% to forecast for mid horizon (8–15 days) to capture momentum.

If sentiment is negative (≤0.33) and price is near recent low, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for late horizon (16–30 days) to counteract bearish bias.

If sentiment spikes to 1.00 within 3 days, adjust forecast downward by 0.5–1.0% for next 5 days to reflect sudden market cooling.

If sentiment is stable at 0.67–0.33 over 7+ days, apply linear decay correction: subtract 0.1–0.3% per day for late horizon to reflect diminishing momentum.

If forecast exceeds true value by >2% for 3 consecutive days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% per day for next 5 days to prevent overcorrection.
